definitions.ask: Where should captured notes (and every other unmarked task sub-bullet) live?
definitions.why: Research adjustment A3, which you endorsed; the micro marker alone separates work from notes

choices.label: Loose bullets that read as an implicit NOTES drawer; capture writes them as today
A physical NOTES drawer created on demand; captured notes nest one level deeper

definitions.ask: How should Obsidian toggle the micro task marker on the current bullet?
definitions.why: Ctrl+] already writes exactly the bare `[ ] ` marker in Obsidian

choices.label: Teach the existing Ctrl+] checkbox toggle as the micro toggle; no new chord
Also add a nav Ctrl+G leader whose T toggles it, matching the capture panel

definitions.ask: Add the new Micro Task glossary strand?
definitions.requested: As a part of this change, we should add an excellent new glossary term for "micro task".

definitions.ask: Update the Capture Alias strand so it covers the `..` micro marker alias?
definitions.corrects: swaps for the [[capture]] sigil it stands for, only where that sigil would act at the caret by opening its picker or filling a close slot.

definitions.ask: Record the micro task decision and mark Capture Bullets Mirror The Task Block superseded in part?
definitions.corrects: every other first-level bullet, with its nested bullets, is one note.
